decisions.decision: The new release stores deadlines as optional fields on tickets in the existing version 1 JSON file, which 1.4.0 can read but will strip on any save, so operators must retain the upgraded data to carry those deadlines forward when they reactivate the feature.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have expected to roll back, keep accepting ticket changes, and later upgrade again with both those changes and all previously assigned deadlines preserved automatically.

decisions.decision: An invalid response-hours override is rejected at startup with an error naming the offending variable, which can stop a flag-off rollout before the service listens.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have wanted the service to stay available using the default for that priority and warn operators about the invalid override.
decisions.where: repo/docs/shiploop/spec.md:6 (R-1 validation) and :15 (R-3 startup backfill); repo/README.md:35 (startup configuration errors)

decisions.decision: The migration replaces the whole data file atomically when it adds deadlines and retains the one-writer-per-file deployment model during rollout and rollback.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have expected a rollout that lets the old release keep accepting ticket writes while the new release prepares the deadlines and coordinates the handoff.

decisions.decision: Backfill calculates each missing deadline using the priority currently stored on the ticket, even when that priority has changed since the ticket was created.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have meant to use the original priority from ticket history so the deadline reflects the response time associated with the ticket when it arrived.
decisions.where: repo/docs/shiploop/spec.md:15 (R-3 uses the persisted ticket's creation time and priority)

decisions.decision: Backfill uses the response hours configured at the startup that first fills each missing deadline.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have meant to apply the stated default hours to legacy tickets and reserve overrides for newly created tickets.
decisions.where: repo/docs/shiploop/spec.md:5–6 (R-1 settings) and :15 (R-3 backfill and restart with different hours); record/03-research.md:16 (chosen settings and backfill)

decisions.decision: The work is delivered as local source and operator documentation, with production rollout and activation left to operators.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have expected the production migration and activation to be carried out as part of the change.

decisions.decision: With `overdue=true`, a ticket must be overdue and, when both `status` and `priority` are supplied, match either of those two filters as in the existing implementation.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have expected overdue results to match both supplied filters, following the API documentation's description of how filters combine.
decisions.where: record/03-research.md:16 (preserve existing OR and require overdue); repo/docs/shiploop/spec.md:11 (R-2); repo/docs/api.md:76–77 (documented filter behavior)

decisions.decision: The backfill adds deadlines without recording them in ticket history or queuing notifications for the affected tickets.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have wanted the first assignment of a deadline to appear in each ticket's audit history so agents can see when the promise took effect.
decisions.where: repo/docs/shiploop/spec.md:15 (R-3 requires unchanged audit and outbox data)

decisions.decision: The overdue filter runs before cursor pagination, so the page size and next cursor apply to matching overdue tickets.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have expected to reuse ordinary ticket page boundaries and show just the overdue tickets from each page, even when that produces short or empty pages.

decisions.decision: The HTTP API returns `due` as a UTC ISO 8601 string, using the same convention as the existing ticket timestamps.
decisions.alternative: The requester might have wanted a numeric timestamp for clients that compare deadlines directly.
decisions.where: repo/docs/shiploop/spec.md:5 (R-1 exact UTC ISO response times); repo/docs/api.md:10 (timestamp convention)
